findings.title: Cache is not re-checked after taking the write lock.
findings.body: If several requests arrive while the cache is still empty (for example, right after startup), each one sees `ret == nil` under the read lock and then waits for the write lock. They then rebuild the assets one after another, even though the first one has already filled the cache. Each rebuild re-reads and re-parses the manifest while holding the exclusive lock, which also blocks every reader. The fix is to check `entryPointAssetsCache` again once the write lock is held and return it if another goroutine has already filled it.
